# AirStack

Sourced software market intelligence: facts from the product's own pages and public registries, each with its source and read date.

- Products: https://airstack.bot/p/
- Categories: https://airstack.bot/c/
- Software types: https://airstack.bot/t/
- Makers: https://airstack.bot/o/
- Insights: https://airstack.bot/insights/
- Calendar: https://airstack.bot/calendar/
- Method: https://airstack.bot/method/
- Changes: https://airstack.bot/changes.atom
- Open data: https://airstack.bot/open-data/
- Source and local MCP: https://github.com/OttObottr/airstack
